name: mern-school-management-system
description: Single-project setup: run both backend and frontend with one command, deploy both to Vercel as one project.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r ml-service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND -c magenta,blue,green "cd ml-service && python app.py" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run install-all && npm run build --prefix frontend
